prompt: Build a voxel island in Three.js with a seven-tier pagoda on a plaza, a lake with koi, and a hill to the north. Seed from the URL. Day-night cycle of two minutes.
Here is a voxel island with a lake (use the voxel-worlds layout). Add a wooden bridge with pillars across the narrow side of the lake, railings included, placed on the ground at both ends.
Add a lantern festival at night: 100 paper lanterns rise from the plaza after sunset, drift with the wind, glow, and fade out above the clouds. Nothing happens by day.
Add a fox that wanders the meadow: a walk and a sit state, legs that swing while it walks, a tail that sways, always on the ground.
Add rain as a toggle: 1,500 instanced drops that fall and reset, a darker sky and dimmer sun while it rains, puddles on the plaza, and a rain sound bed.
Add a second small island to the south-east with its own three-tier pagoda, a sandy coast, and a few pines. Connect nothing yet.
Add a shrine bell in a wooden frame on the hill: click it to make it swing like a pendulum and ring with a long decay.
Add quality presets low, medium and high as chips in the panel: pixel ratio, shadows and bloom change without a rebuild. Show the fps in the HUD.
Add ambient sound that starts on the first click: wind from filtered noise that follows a wind strength, water near the lake, a bird chirp by day and a temple bell by night.
Add a flock of twelve birds that circle the pagoda with flocking rules (separation, alignment, cohesion) and land on the roof at dusk.
Add cherry blossom petals: 400 instanced petals released from the trees, carried by the wind, settling on the ground and the lake for a while before they vanish.
Add a stone path with eight lanterns from the pier to the plaza, following the ground; the lanterns glow after sunset.
Add a minimap in the corner: a top-down canvas of the terrain colours with the camera's view cone drawn on it, updated every frame.
Add snow as a weather toggle: falling flakes, a white cover that grows on the top voxels over 30 seconds, a colder sky tint; it melts when the toggle is off.
Add a boat that sails around the island on the sea, bobbing with the waves, with a sailor figure and a sail that turns into the wind.
Add a waterfall on the north hill: a scrolling water texture down the cliff, a pool at the bottom that joins the lake, and splash particles.
Add a build mode: a chip that turns clicks into placing a voxel of the chosen colour on the face you clicked, right-click removes; the HUD shows the voxel count.
Add camera presets as number keys 1 to 4: an overview, the pagoda door, the lake shore, the hill top, each flown to over two seconds with easing.
Add fireworks after dark: a rocket every few seconds with a whistle, a burst of 200 sparks in one of three colours with a bang, embers that fall. None by day.

Build a voxel island with a pagoda and a lake, then add these six features in order, one at a time, keeping the frame rate at the baseline you measured after the island: (1) a wooden bridge over the lake, (2) a deer that grazes and walks, (3) a day-night cycle with lanterns, (4) ambient sound on the first click, (5) a cherry blossom storm as a toggle, (6) fireworks at night. Keep a TODO.md with the fps after each.
